[RFCS.23.1] **A fact leaves the engine as a `FactExternal`**
(`proto/fact_external.proto#FactExternal`): a portable value, not a stream
atom. It is the form of a fact published to another tier ([NCBK.10]) or passed
as a call argument ([LADP.8.6.1]).

Unlike `FactAssert` ([RFCS.6]) it needs no `SchemaDef` or `Slot` atom to decode,
carries nothing local to one stream, and has no stream role: it decodes without
the program that wrote it. Its fields carry their slot names, so a receiver
matches them by name.
